note: Shabbat Shkalim (Sabbath of Shekels) falls on (or just before) the 1st of Adar (or Adar II). It adds a special reading from Exodus 30:11–16. This helped remind the men of Israel to give half a shekel to support the Temple in time for Passover. In Temple times, the money was collected at this time of year.
